title: LapIRN
paper_title: Laplacian Pyramid Networks for Fast Deformable Registration of Large Deformation
core_mech: LapIRN 把配准写成 Laplacian 金字塔上的三层残差流：每层先 warp，再让下一层只修正剩余误差。
core_mech_en: Decomposes large-deformation 3D registration into a 3-level coarse-to-fine Laplacian image pyramid where each level warps the previous estimate and refines only the residual displacement.
input_desc: moving 体积 Im 与 fixed 体积 If
input_en: 3D moving volume I_m and fixed volume I_f decomposed into a 3-level Gaussian/Laplacian pyramid
output_desc: 组合位移场、形变后的 moving 图像与可选 diffeomorphic 场
output_en: Composed full-resolution deformation field (or stationary velocity diffeomorphism) and warped volume

adapter.name: LapIRN
adapter.mechanism: Three coarse-to-fine registration stages warp previous estimates and compose residual displacement corrections.
limitations: Small custom networks and displacement composition; not the original Laplacian residual-feature decoder or diffeomorphic variant.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
